validation.notes: Root cause: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() discarded the result of options.resolveProjectTrust and unconditionally called settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(true). A denied trust decision therefore became an approval, so the final package resolve() included project resources and the loader exposed project extensions after a fresh reload. Fix: persist the decision (setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted)) so deny stays denied while approve still enables project resources; the bootstrap pass in loadProjectTrustExtensions() continues to force untrusted and is unchanged. .prale-eval/regression.mjs drives the real resource-loader.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createTrustSubject with fs-backed package/extension boundary fakes and asserts: (1) the bootstrap pass exposes only user+cli extensions and no project extension; (2) after resolveProjectTrust returns false the loaded set is exactly cli+user with no project extension and state.trusted stays false; (3) after it returns true the set is cli+project+user and state.trusted is true; (4) a fresh reload that approves and is then denied drops project resources again, and a plain subsequent reload keeps them absent. Verified bidirectionally: with the original setProjectTrusted(true) line restored the script exits 1 with AssertionError 'denied trust must keep project resources absent, got [cli, project, user]'; with the fix it exits 0. Note: repo vitest suites could not be executed because node_modules/dependencies are not installed in this workspace and installing them was out of scope; validation is the dependency-free Node 24 regression above, which loads and executes the real production module.
